# ============================================================================
# PART 1: Model Training / Checkpoint Loading
# ============================================================================

# Training hyperparameters (from train.yaml)
TASK_ENV = os.environ.get("JEPA_ENV", "two-rooms")
ENV_NAME = TASK_ENV.replace("-", "_")
SEED = int(os.environ.get("SEED", "42"))
PLAN_LENGTH = int(os.environ.get("PLAN_LENGTH", "90"))
OUTPUT_DIR = Path(os.environ.get("OUTPUT_DIR", "/workspace/eb_jepa/outputs"))
CKPT_DIR = OUTPUT_DIR / "checkpoints"
CKPT_PATH = CKPT_DIR / "ac_jepa.pth.tar"
PRETRAINED_CKPT_PATH = Path(
    os.environ.get(
        "JEPA_PRETRAINED_CKPT",
        "/data/eb_jepa/checkpoints/ac_jepa_e11.pth.tar",
    )
)
FORCE_TRAIN = os.environ.get("JEPA_FORCE_TRAIN", "0") == "1"
EPOCHS = 12
BATCH_SIZE = 384
LR = 0.001
WEIGHT_DECAY = 1e-5
GRAD_CLIP = 2.0
DOBS = 2
HENC = 32
DSTC = 32
NSTEPS = 8
COV_COEFF = 8
STD_COEFF = 16
SIM_COEFF_T = 12
IDM_COEFF = 1


def build_data_cfg(batch_size):
    """Create the shared dataset config for the selected environment."""
    return {
        "env_name": ENV_NAME,
        "batch_size": batch_size,
        "num_workers": 0,
        "pin_mem": False,
        "persistent_workers": False,
    }


def resolve_checkpoint_path():
    """Choose the released checkpoint by default, with local fallback."""
    if not FORCE_TRAIN and PRETRAINED_CKPT_PATH.exists():
        return PRETRAINED_CKPT_PATH
    if CKPT_PATH.exists():
        return CKPT_PATH
    return None


def setup_seed(seed):
    """Set random seeds for reproducibility."""
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed(seed)
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)


def build_model(device, loader):
    """Build the JEPA model with all components."""
    img_size = loader.dataset.config.img_size

    # Encoder
    encoder = ImpalaEncoder(
        width=1,
        stack_sizes=(16, HENC, DSTC),
        num_blocks=2,
        dropout_rate=None,
        layer_norm=False,
        input_channels=DOBS,
        final_ln=True,
        mlp_output_dim=512,
        input_shape=(DOBS, img_size, img_size),
    )
    test_input = torch.rand((1, DOBS, 1, img_size, img_size))
    test_output = encoder(test_input)
    _, f, _, h, w = test_output.shape

    # Predictor
    predictor = RNNPredictor(
        hidden_size=encoder.mlp_output_dim, final_ln=encoder.final_ln
    )

    # Action encoder (identity)
    aencoder = nn.Identity()

    # IDM
    idm = InverseDynamicsModel(
        state_dim=h * w * f,
        hidden_dim=256,
        action_dim=2,
    ).to(device)

    # Regularizer
    regularizer = VC_IDM_Sim_Regularizer(
        cov_coeff=COV_COEFF,
        std_coeff=STD_COEFF,
        sim_coeff_t=SIM_COEFF_T,
        idm_coeff=IDM_COEFF,
        idm=idm,
        first_t_only=False,
        projector=None,
        spatial_as_samples=False,
        idm_after_proj=False,
        sim_t_after_proj=False,
    )

    # Loss and JEPA
    ploss = SquareLossSeq()
    jepa = JEPA(encoder, aencoder, predictor, regularizer, ploss).to(device)

    # Position prober
    xy_head = MLPXYHead(
        input_shape=test_output.shape[1],
        normalizer=loader.dataset.normalizer,
    ).to(device)
    xy_prober = JEPAProbe(jepa=jepa, head=xy_head, hcost=nn.MSELoss())

    return jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, test_output.shape


def train_model(device):
    """Train the AC Video JEPA model and save checkpoint."""
    print("Training AC Video JEPA model...")

    loader, val_loader, data_config = init_data(
        env_name=ENV_NAME,
        cfg_data=build_data_cfg(BATCH_SIZE),
    )

    jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, _ = build_model(device, loader)

    steps_per_epoch = data_config.size // data_config.batch_size
    total_steps = EPOCHS * steps_per_epoch

    jepa_optimizer = AdamW(jepa.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=WEIGHT_DECAY)
    jepa_scheduler = CosineWithWarmup(jepa_optimizer, total_steps, warmup_ratio=0.1)

    probe_optimizer = AdamW(xy_head.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-5)
    probe_scheduler = CosineWithWarmup(probe_optimizer, total_steps, warmup_ratio=0.1)

    dtype = torch.bfloat16
    use_amp = True
    scaler = GradScaler(device.type, enabled=use_amp)

    for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
        epoch_start = time.time()
        pbar = tqdm(
            enumerate(loader),
            total=len(loader),
            desc=f"Epoch {epoch}/{EPOCHS - 1}",
        )
        for idx, (x, a, loc, _, _) in pbar:
            x = x.to(device)
            a = a.to(device)
            loc = loc.to(device)
            total_loss = torch.tensor(0.0, device=device)

            # JEPA loss
            jepa_optimizer.zero_grad()
            with autocast(device.type, enabled=use_amp, dtype=dtype):
                _, (jepa_loss, regl, regl_unweight, regldict, pl) = jepa.unroll(
                    x, a,
                    nsteps=NSTEPS,
                    unroll_mode="autoregressive",
                    ctxt_window_time=1,
                    compute_loss=True,
                    return_all_steps=False,
                )
                total_loss += jepa_loss

            scaler.scale(jepa_loss).backward()
            scaler.unscale_(jepa_optimizer)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(jepa.encoder.parameters(), GRAD_CLIP)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(jepa.predictor.parameters(), GRAD_CLIP)
            scaler.step(jepa_optimizer)
            scaler.update()
            jepa_scheduler.step()

            # Probe loss
            probe_optimizer.zero_grad()
            with autocast(device.type, enabled=use_amp, dtype=dtype):
                xy_loss = xy_prober(
                    observations=x[:, :, :1],
                    targets=loc[:, :, :1],
                )
                xy_loss = loader.dataset.normalizer.unnormalize_mse(xy_loss)
                total_loss += xy_loss

            scaler.scale(xy_loss).backward()
            scaler.step(probe_optimizer)
            scaler.update()
            probe_scheduler.step()

            pbar.set_postfix({
                "loss": f"{total_loss.item():.4f}",
                "reg": f"{regl.item():.4f}",
                "pred": f"{pl.item():.4f}",
            })

        epoch_time = time.time() - epoch_start
        print(
            f"TRAIN_METRICS: epoch={epoch}, loss={total_loss.item():.4f}, "
            f"reg={regl.item():.4f}, pred={pl.item():.4f}, "
            f"probe={xy_loss.item():.4f}, time={epoch_time:.1f}s",
            flush=True,
        )

    # Save checkpoint
    os.makedirs(CKPT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    ckpt = {
        "epoch": EPOCHS - 1,
        "model_state_dict": jepa.state_dict(),
        "xy_head_state_dict": xy_head.state_dict(),
    }
    torch.save(ckpt, CKPT_PATH)
    print(f"Checkpoint saved to {CKPT_PATH}", flush=True)

    return jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, loader


def load_model(device):
    """Load the JEPA model from checkpoint."""
    loader, val_loader, data_config = init_data(
        env_name=ENV_NAME,
        cfg_data=build_data_cfg(64),
    )

    jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, _ = build_model(device, loader)

    checkpoint_path = resolve_checkpoint_path()
    if checkpoint_path is None:
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"No checkpoint found at {PRETRAINED_CKPT_PATH} or {CKPT_PATH}"
        )
    print(f"Loading checkpoint from {checkpoint_path}...", flush=True)
    checkpoint = torch.load(checkpoint_path, map_location=device, weights_only=False)
    state_dict = checkpoint.get("model_state_dict", {})
    state_dict = {k.replace("_orig_mod.", ""): v for k, v in state_dict.items()}
    jepa.load_state_dict(state_dict)

    if "xy_head_state_dict" in checkpoint:
        xy_head.load_state_dict(checkpoint["xy_head_state_dict"])

    print("Model loaded successfully.", flush=True)
    return jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, loader


# ============================================================================
# PART 2: Custom Planner (EDITABLE REGION)
# ============================================================================

# EDITABLE REGION START
class CustomPlanner(Planner):
    """Temporally-Correlated CEM (TC-CEM) planner for JEPA world models.

    Novel contribution — Temporal correlation prior for action sampling:
    Standard CEM/MPPI sample actions i.i.d. across time steps, wasting
    samples on physically implausible trajectories that oscillate wildly.
    TC-CEM injects a temporal smoothness prior by low-pass filtering the
    random perturbations before adding them to the distribution mean.
    This (1) reduces the effective search-space dimensionality, (2) produces
    coherent action sequences that respect the physical continuity of the
    environment, and (3) yields faster convergence with the same sample
    budget.  Momentum on the mean further stabilises optimisation across
    CEM iterations.
    """

    def __init__(self, unroll, action_dim=2, plan_length=15,
                 num_samples=200, n_iters=20, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(unroll)
        self.action_dim = action_dim
        self.plan_length = plan_length
        self.num_samples = num_samples
        self.n_iters = n_iters
        self.num_elites = max(10, num_samples // 10)
        self.var_scale = 1.5
        self.momentum = 0.3
        self.smooth_half_window = 2            # ±2 → 5-tap triangular filter
        self.device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

    @torch.no_grad()
    def plan(self, obs_init, steps_left=None, eval_mode=True,
             t0=False, plan_vis_path=None):
        from einops import rearrange
        import torch.nn.functional as F

        plan_length = min(self.plan_length, steps_left) if steps_left else self.plan_length

        # ---- build triangular (linear-decay) smoothing kernel ---------------
        hw = self.smooth_half_window
        w = 2 * hw + 1
        tri = torch.cat([torch.arange(1, hw + 2, device=self.device),
                         torch.arange(hw, 0, -1, device=self.device)])
        tri = tri / tri.sum()                  # normalised, sum = 1
        kernel = tri.view(1, 1, w)             # [1, 1, W] for grouped conv1d
        # variance correction: Var(filtered) ≈ Var(white) * sum(k_i²)
        var_correction = 1.0 / (tri.square().sum().sqrt() + 1e-8)

        # ---- initialise distribution ----------------------------------------
        mean = torch.zeros(plan_length, self.action_dim, device=self.device)
        std = self.var_scale * torch.ones(plan_length, self.action_dim,
                                          device=self.device)

        for _ in range(self.n_iters):
            # sample white noise  [T, B, A]
            noise = torch.randn(plan_length, self.num_samples,
                                self.action_dim, device=self.device)

            # temporal smoothing via 1D convolution (causal-free, symmetric)
            # reshape → [B*A, 1, T] for grouped conv
            noise_r = noise.permute(1, 2, 0).reshape(-1, 1, plan_length)
            noise_s = F.conv1d(noise_r, kernel, padding='same')
            # restore shape [T, B, A] and correct variance
            noise_s = (noise_s * var_correction).reshape(
                self.num_samples, self.action_dim, plan_length).permute(2, 0, 1)

            # form actions: mean + std * smoothed_noise
            actions = mean.unsqueeze(1) + std.unsqueeze(1) * noise_s

            # clip to max-norm ball
            max_norm = 2.45
            norms = actions.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
            actions = actions * (max_norm / norms.clamp(min=1e-6)).clamp(max=1.0)

            # evaluate
            cost = self.cost_function(
                rearrange(actions, "t b a -> b a t"), obs_init
            )

            # elite selection
            elite_idxs = torch.topk(-cost, self.num_elites, dim=0).indices
            elite_actions = actions[:, elite_idxs]          # [T, K, A]

            # momentum-augmented mean update
            new_mean = elite_actions.mean(dim=1)            # [T, A]
            mean = (1.0 - self.momentum) * new_mean + self.momentum * mean

            # std from elites (with floor for exploration)
            std = self.var_scale * elite_actions.std(dim=1).clamp(min=0.15)

        return PlanningResult(actions=mean)
# EDITABLE REGION END


# ============================================================================
# PART 3: Planning Evaluation
# ============================================================================

def create_env(data_config):
    """Create the Two Rooms evaluation environment."""
    if ENV_NAME != "two_rooms":
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported ENV='{TASK_ENV}' for jepa-planning")
    return DotWall(
        config=data_config,
        n_allowed_steps=200,
        level="normal",
    )


def run_planning_eval(jepa, xy_prober, loader, device, num_episodes=20):
    """Run planning evaluation with the CustomPlanner."""
    jepa.eval()
    # Disable cudnn for RNN backward in eval mode — gradient-based planners
    # (CEM-with-grad, MPPI-grad) need to backprop through RNN predictor; cudnn
    # raises "RNN backward only in training mode" otherwise. Falls back to
    # native PyTorch RNN ops which support eval-mode backward.
    torch.backends.cudnn.enabled = False

    data_config = loader.dataset.config
    env = create_env(data_config)
    env.reset()

    # Create a lightweight GCAgent-like wrapper that uses CustomPlanner
    normalizer = env.normalizer

    # Create the planner
    planner = CustomPlanner(
        unroll=None,  # Will be set via agent wrapper
        action_dim=2,
        plan_length=PLAN_LENGTH,
        num_samples=200,
        n_iters=20,
    )

    # We need to wire up the unroll function properly
    # The planner needs access to model unroll through the GCAgent's unroll method
    class PlanningAgent:
        def __init__(self, model, planner, normalizer, env, prober):
            self.model = model
            self.planner = planner
            self.normalizer = normalizer
            self.env = env
            self.device = next(model.parameters()).device
            self.loc_prober = prober
            self.goal_state = None
            self.goal_position = None
            self.goal_state_enc = None
            self.objective = None
            self.num_act_stepped = 1

            # Wire planner's unroll to agent's unroll
            self.planner.unroll = self.unroll

        def unroll(self, obs_init, actions, repeat_batch=True):
            batch_size = actions.shape[0]
            nsteps = actions.shape[2]
            if repeat_batch:
                obs_init_rep = obs_init.repeat(batch_size, 1, 1, 1, 1)
            else:
                obs_init_rep = obs_init
            predicted_states, _ = self.model.unroll(
                obs_init_rep, actions,
                nsteps=nsteps,
                unroll_mode="autoregressive",
                ctxt_window_time=1,
                compute_loss=False,
                return_all_steps=False,
            )
            return predicted_states

        def set_goal(self, goal_state, goal_position=None):
            self.goal_position = goal_position
            self.goal_state = goal_state
            self.goal_state_enc = self.model.encode(
                self.normalizer.normalize_state(goal_state.to(self.device))
                .unsqueeze(0)
                .unsqueeze(2)
            )
            self.objective = ReprTargetDistMPCObjective(
                target_enc=self.goal_state_enc,
                sum_all_diffs=True,
            )
            self.planner.set_objective(self.objective)

        def act(self, obs_tensor, steps_left=None, t0=False):
            planning_result = self.planner.plan(
                obs_tensor,
                steps_left=steps_left,
                eval_mode=True,
                t0=t0,
            )
            return planning_result.actions[:self.num_act_stepped]

    agent = PlanningAgent(jepa, planner, normalizer, env, xy_prober)

    successes = []
    distances = []
    steps_to_success = []

    for ep in range(num_episodes):
        obs, info = env.reset()
        obs, reward, done, truncated, info = env.step(
            np.zeros(env.action_space.shape[0])
        )
        goal_img = info["target_obs"]

        agent.set_goal(
            goal_img.detach().clone().to(dtype=torch.float32),
            info["target_position"],
        )

        steps_left = env.n_allowed_steps
        total_steps = env.n_allowed_steps
        t0 = True
        success = False
        state_dist = float("inf")
        first_success_step = None

        while steps_left > 0:
            obs_tensor = (
                normalizer.normalize_state(
                    obs.detach().clone().to(dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
                )
                .unsqueeze(0)
                .unsqueeze(2)
            )
            with torch.no_grad():
                action = agent.act(
                    obs_tensor, steps_left=steps_left, t0=t0
                ).cpu().numpy()

            for a in action:
                obs, reward, done, truncated, info = env.step(a)
                t0 = False
                steps_left -= 1

                eval_results = env.eval_state(
                    info["target_position"], info["dot_position"]
                )
                success = eval_results["success"]
                state_dist = eval_results["state_dist"]

                if success and first_success_step is None:
                    first_success_step = total_steps - steps_left
                if done or truncated or steps_left <= 0:
                    break
            if done or truncated:
                break

        successes.append(success)
        distances.append(state_dist)
        if first_success_step is not None:
            steps_to_success.append(first_success_step)
        print(
            f"PLAN_METRICS: episode={ep}, success={success}, dist={state_dist:.4f}",
            flush=True,
        )

    success_rate = np.mean(successes)
    mean_dist = np.mean(distances)
    mean_steps = np.mean(steps_to_success) if steps_to_success else float("nan")
    print(
        f"TEST_METRICS: success_rate={success_rate:.2f}, "
        f"mean_dist={mean_dist:.4f}, "
        f"mean_steps_to_success={mean_steps:.2f}",
        flush=True,
    )
    return success_rate, mean_dist


# ============================================================================
# Main Entry Point
# ============================================================================

def main():
    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    setup_seed(SEED)
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    print(f"Using device: {device}", flush=True)
    print(
        f"Runtime config: seed={SEED}, env={TASK_ENV}, output_dir={OUTPUT_DIR}",
        flush=True,
    )

    # Part 1: Load released checkpoint by default, retrain only as a fallback.
    if resolve_checkpoint_path() is not None and not FORCE_TRAIN:
        jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, loader = load_model(device)
    else:
        if FORCE_TRAIN:
            print("JEPA_FORCE_TRAIN=1 -> retraining world model", flush=True)
        else:
            print(
                f"Released checkpoint missing at {PRETRAINED_CKPT_PATH}; "
                "falling back to local training.",
                flush=True,
            )
        jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, loader = train_model(device)

    # Part 3: Planning evaluation
    success_rate, mean_dist = run_planning_eval(
        jepa, xy_prober, loader, device, num_episodes=20
    )
    print(f"\nFinal Results: success_rate={success_rate:.2f}, mean_dist={mean_dist:.4f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        idm_after_proj=False,
        sim_t_after_proj=False,
    )

    # Loss and JEPA
    ploss = SquareLossSeq()
    jepa = JEPA(encoder, aencoder, predictor, regularizer, ploss).to(device)

    # Position prober
    xy_head = MLPXYHead(
        input_shape=test_output.shape[1],
        normalizer=loader.dataset.normalizer,
    ).to(device)
    xy_prober = JEPAProbe(jepa=jepa, head=xy_head, hcost=nn.MSELoss())

    return jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, test_output.shape


def train_model(device):
    """Train the AC Video JEPA model and save checkpoint."""
    print("Training AC Video JEPA model...")

    loader, val_loader, data_config = init_data(
        env_name=ENV_NAME,
        cfg_data=build_data_cfg(BATCH_SIZE),
    )

    jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, _ = build_model(device, loader)

    steps_per_epoch = data_config.size // data_config.batch_size
    total_steps = EPOCHS * steps_per_epoch

    jepa_optimizer = AdamW(jepa.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=WEIGHT_DECAY)
    jepa_scheduler = CosineWithWarmup(jepa_optimizer, total_steps, warmup_ratio=0.1)

    probe_optimizer = AdamW(xy_head.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-5)
    probe_scheduler = CosineWithWarmup(probe_optimizer, total_steps, warmup_ratio=0.1)

    dtype = torch.bfloat16
    use_amp = True
    scaler = GradScaler(device.type, enabled=use_amp)

    for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
        epoch_start = time.time()
        pbar = tqdm(
            enumerate(loader),
            total=len(loader),
            desc=f"Epoch {epoch}/{EPOCHS - 1}",
        )
        for idx, (x, a, loc, _, _) in pbar:
            x = x.to(device)
            a = a.to(device)
            loc = loc.to(device)
            total_loss = torch.tensor(0.0, device=device)

            # JEPA loss
            jepa_optimizer.zero_grad()
            with autocast(device.type, enabled=use_amp, dtype=dtype):
                _, (jepa_loss, regl, regl_unweight, regldict, pl) = jepa.unroll(
                    x, a,
                    nsteps=NSTEPS,
                    unroll_mode="autoregressive",
                    ctxt_window_time=1,
                    compute_loss=True,
                    return_all_steps=False,
                )
                total_loss += jepa_loss

            scaler.scale(jepa_loss).backward()
            scaler.unscale_(jepa_optimizer)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(jepa.encoder.parameters(), GRAD_CLIP)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(jepa.predictor.parameters(), GRAD_CLIP)
            scaler.step(jepa_optimizer)
            scaler.update()
            jepa_scheduler.step()

            # Probe loss
            probe_optimizer.zero_grad()
            with autocast(device.type, enabled=use_amp, dtype=dtype):
                xy_loss = xy_prober(
                    observations=x[:, :, :1],
                    targets=loc[:, :, :1],
                )
                xy_loss = loader.dataset.normalizer.unnormalize_mse(xy_loss)
                total_loss += xy_loss

            scaler.scale(xy_loss).backward()
            scaler.step(probe_optimizer)
            scaler.update()
            probe_scheduler.step()

            pbar.set_postfix({
                "loss": f"{total_loss.item():.4f}",
                "reg": f"{regl.item():.4f}",
                "pred": f"{pl.item():.4f}",
            })

        epoch_time = time.time() - epoch_start
        print(
            f"TRAIN_METRICS: epoch={epoch}, loss={total_loss.item():.4f}, "
            f"reg={regl.item():.4f}, pred={pl.item():.4f}, "
            f"probe={xy_loss.item():.4f}, time={epoch_time:.1f}s",
            flush=True,
        )

    # Save checkpoint
    os.makedirs(CKPT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    ckpt = {
        "epoch": EPOCHS - 1,
        "model_state_dict": jepa.state_dict(),
        "xy_head_state_dict": xy_head.state_dict(),
    }
    torch.save(ckpt, CKPT_PATH)
    print(f"Checkpoint saved to {CKPT_PATH}", flush=True)

    return jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, loader


def load_model(device):
    """Load the JEPA model from checkpoint."""
    loader, val_loader, data_config = init_data(
        env_name=ENV_NAME,
        cfg_data=build_data_cfg(64),
    )

    jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, _ = build_model(device, loader)

    checkpoint_path = resolve_checkpoint_path()
    if checkpoint_path is None:
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"No checkpoint found at {PRETRAINED_CKPT_PATH} or {CKPT_PATH}"
        )
    print(f"Loading checkpoint from {checkpoint_path}...", flush=True)
    checkpoint = torch.load(checkpoint_path, map_location=device, weights_only=False)
    state_dict = checkpoint.get("model_state_dict", {})
    state_dict = {k.replace("_orig_mod.", ""): v for k, v in state_dict.items()}
    jepa.load_state_dict(state_dict)

    if "xy_head_state_dict" in checkpoint:
        xy_head.load_state_dict(checkpoint["xy_head_state_dict"])

    print("Model loaded successfully.", flush=True)
    return jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, loader


# ============================================================================
# PART 2: Custom Planner (EDITABLE REGION)
# ============================================================================

# EDITABLE REGION START
class CustomPlanner(Planner):
    """Custom planning algorithm for JEPA world models.

    Uses the learned JEPA world model to search for optimal action
    sequences that reach a specified goal state.

    Available methods (inherited from Planner):
        self.unroll(obs_init, actions): Forward simulate actions through world model
            obs_init: [1, C, 1, H, W] initial observation encoding
            actions: [B, A, T] action sequences to evaluate
            Returns: [B, D, T+1, H, W] predicted state encodings

        self.objective(encodings): Compute cost for predicted encodings
            encodings: [B, D, T, H, W]
            Returns: [B] cost per sample (lower is better)

        self.cost_function(actions, obs_init): Convenience method
            Calls unroll then objective
            Returns: [B] cost per sample

    plan() must return PlanningResult(actions=Tensor[T, A], ...)
    """

    def __init__(self, unroll, action_dim=2, plan_length=15,
                 num_samples=200, n_iters=20, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(unroll)
        self.action_dim = action_dim
        self.plan_length = plan_length
        self.num_samples = num_samples
        self.n_iters = n_iters
        self.num_elites = max(20, num_samples // 10)
        self.var_scale = 1.5
        self.device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

    @torch.no_grad()
    def plan(self, obs_init, steps_left=None, eval_mode=True,
             t0=False, plan_vis_path=None):
        from einops import rearrange

        plan_length = min(self.plan_length, steps_left) if steps_left else self.plan_length

        mean = torch.zeros(plan_length, self.action_dim, device=self.device)
        std = self.var_scale * torch.ones(plan_length, self.action_dim, device=self.device)
        actions = torch.empty(plan_length, self.num_samples, self.action_dim, device=self.device)

        for _ in range(self.n_iters):
            actions[:, :] = mean.unsqueeze(1) + std.unsqueeze(1) * torch.randn(
                plan_length, self.num_samples, self.action_dim, device=self.device,
            )

            cost = self.cost_function(
                rearrange(actions, "t b a -> b a t"), obs_init
            ).unsqueeze(1)

            elite_idxs = torch.topk(-cost.squeeze(1), self.num_elites, dim=0).indices
            elite_actions = actions[:, elite_idxs]

            mean = elite_actions.mean(dim=1)
            std = elite_actions.std(dim=1) + 1e-6

        return PlanningResult(actions=mean)
# EDITABLE REGION END


# ============================================================================
# PART 3: Planning Evaluation
# ============================================================================

def create_env(data_config):
    """Create the Two Rooms evaluation environment."""
    if ENV_NAME != "two_rooms":
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported ENV='{TASK_ENV}' for jepa-planning")
    return DotWall(
        config=data_config,
        n_allowed_steps=200,
        level="normal",
    )


def run_planning_eval(jepa, xy_prober, loader, device, num_episodes=20):
    """Run planning evaluation with the CustomPlanner."""
    jepa.eval()
    # Disable cudnn for RNN backward in eval mode — gradient-based planners
    # (CEM-with-grad, MPPI-grad) need to backprop through RNN predictor; cudnn
    # raises "RNN backward only in training mode" otherwise. Falls back to
    # native PyTorch RNN ops which support eval-mode backward.
    torch.backends.cudnn.enabled = False

    data_config = loader.dataset.config
    env = create_env(data_config)
    env.reset()

    # Create a lightweight GCAgent-like wrapper that uses CustomPlanner
    normalizer = env.normalizer

    # Create the planner
    planner = CustomPlanner(
        unroll=None,  # Will be set via agent wrapper
        action_dim=2,
        plan_length=PLAN_LENGTH,
        num_samples=200,
        n_iters=20,
    )

    # We need to wire up the unroll function properly
    # The planner needs access to model unroll through the GCAgent's unroll method
    class PlanningAgent:
        def __init__(self, model, planner, normalizer, env, prober):
            self.model = model
            self.planner = planner
            self.normalizer = normalizer
            self.env = env
            self.device = next(model.parameters()).device
            self.loc_prober = prober
            self.goal_state = None
            self.goal_position = None
            self.goal_state_enc = None
            self.objective = None
            self.num_act_stepped = 1

            # Wire planner's unroll to agent's unroll
            self.planner.unroll = self.unroll

        def unroll(self, obs_init, actions, repeat_batch=True):
            batch_size = actions.shape[0]
            nsteps = actions.shape[2]
            if repeat_batch:
                obs_init_rep = obs_init.repeat(batch_size, 1, 1, 1, 1)
            else:
                obs_init_rep = obs_init
            predicted_states, _ = self.model.unroll(
                obs_init_rep, actions,
                nsteps=nsteps,
                unroll_mode="autoregressive",
                ctxt_window_time=1,
                compute_loss=False,
                return_all_steps=False,
            )
            return predicted_states

        def set_goal(self, goal_state, goal_position=None):
            self.goal_position = goal_position
            self.goal_state = goal_state
            self.goal_state_enc = self.model.encode(
                self.normalizer.normalize_state(goal_state.to(self.device))
                .unsqueeze(0)
                .unsqueeze(2)
            )
            self.objective = ReprTargetDistMPCObjective(
                target_enc=self.goal_state_enc,
                sum_all_diffs=True,
            )
            self.planner.set_objective(self.objective)

        def act(self, obs_tensor, steps_left=None, t0=False):
            planning_result = self.planner.plan(
                obs_tensor,
                steps_left=steps_left,
                eval_mode=True,
                t0=t0,
            )
            return planning_result.actions[:self.num_act_stepped]

    agent = PlanningAgent(jepa, planner, normalizer, env, xy_prober)

    successes = []
    distances = []
    steps_to_success = []

    for ep in range(num_episodes):
        obs, info = env.reset()
        obs, reward, done, truncated, info = env.step(
            np.zeros(env.action_space.shape[0])
        )
        goal_img = info["target_obs"]

        agent.set_goal(
            goal_img.detach().clone().to(dtype=torch.float32),
            info["target_position"],
        )

        steps_left = env.n_allowed_steps
        total_steps = env.n_allowed_steps
        t0 = True
        success = False
        state_dist = float("inf")
        first_success_step = None

        while steps_left > 0:
            obs_tensor = (
                normalizer.normalize_state(
                    obs.detach().clone().to(dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
                )
                .unsqueeze(0)
                .unsqueeze(2)
            )
            with torch.no_grad():
                action = agent.act(
                    obs_tensor, steps_left=steps_left, t0=t0
                ).cpu().numpy()

            for a in action:
                obs, reward, done, truncated, info = env.step(a)
                t0 = False
                steps_left -= 1

                eval_results = env.eval_state(
                    info["target_position"], info["dot_position"]
                )
                success = eval_results["success"]
                state_dist = eval_results["state_dist"]

                if success and first_success_step is None:
                    first_success_step = total_steps - steps_left
                if done or truncated or steps_left <= 0:
                    break
            if done or truncated:
                break

        successes.append(success)
        distances.append(state_dist)
        if first_success_step is not None:
            steps_to_success.append(first_success_step)
        print(
            f"PLAN_METRICS: episode={ep}, success={success}, dist={state_dist:.4f}",
            flush=True,
        )

    success_rate = np.mean(successes)
    mean_dist = np.mean(distances)
    mean_steps = np.mean(steps_to_success) if steps_to_success else float("nan")
    print(
        f"TEST_METRICS: success_rate={success_rate:.2f}, "
        f"mean_dist={mean_dist:.4f}, "
        f"mean_steps_to_success={mean_steps:.2f}",
        flush=True,
    )
    return success_rate, mean_dist


# ============================================================================
# Main Entry Point
# ============================================================================

def main():
    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    setup_seed(SEED)
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    print(f"Using device: {device}", flush=True)
    print(
        f"Runtime config: seed={SEED}, env={TASK_ENV}, output_dir={OUTPUT_DIR}",
        flush=True,
    )

    # Part 1: Load released checkpoint by default, retrain only as a fallback.
    if resolve_checkpoint_path() is not None and not FORCE_TRAIN:
        jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, loader = load_model(device)
    else:
        if FORCE_TRAIN:
            print("JEPA_FORCE_TRAIN=1 -> retraining world model", flush=True)
        else:
            print(
                f"Released checkpoint missing at {PRETRAINED_CKPT_PATH}; "
                "falling back to local training.",
                flush=True,
            )
        jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, loader = train_model(device)

    # Part 3: Planning evaluation
    success_rate, mean_dist = run_planning_eval(
        jepa, xy_prober, loader, device, num_episodes=20
    )
    print(f"\nFinal Results: success_rate={success_rate:.2f}, mean_dist={mean_dist:.4f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import random
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.amp import GradScaler, autocast
from torch.optim import AdamW
from tqdm import tqdm

from eb_jepa.architectures import (
    ImpalaEncoder,
    InverseDynamicsModel,
    RNNPredictor,
)
from eb_jepa.datasets.two_rooms.env import DotWall
from eb_jepa.datasets.utils import init_data

)
from eb_jepa.schedulers import CosineWithWarmup
from eb_jepa.state_decoder import MLPXYHead

# ============================================================================
# PART 1: Model Training / Checkpoint Loading
# ============================================================================

# Training hyperparameters (from train.yaml)
TASK_ENV = os.environ.get("JEPA_ENV", "two-rooms")
ENV_NAME = TASK_ENV.replace("-", "_")
SEED = int(os.environ.get("SEED", "42"))
PLAN_LENGTH = int(os.environ.get("PLAN_LENGTH", "90"))
OUTPUT_DIR = Path(os.environ.get("OUTPUT_DIR", "/workspace/eb_jepa/outputs"))
CKPT_DIR = OUTPUT_DIR / "checkpoints"
CKPT_PATH = CKPT_DIR / "ac_jepa.pth.tar"
PRETRAINED_CKPT_PATH = Path(
    os.environ.get(
        "JEPA_PRETRAINED_CKPT",
        "/data/eb_jepa/checkpoints/ac_jepa_e11.pth.tar",
    )
)
FORCE_TRAIN = os.environ.get("JEPA_FORCE_TRAIN", "0") == "1"
EPOCHS = 12
BATCH_SIZE = 384
LR = 0.001
WEIGHT_DECAY = 1e-5
GRAD_CLIP = 2.0
DOBS = 2
HENC = 32
DSTC = 32
NSTEPS = 8
COV_COEFF = 8
STD_COEFF = 16
SIM_COEFF_T = 12
IDM_COEFF = 1


def build_data_cfg(batch_size):
    """Create the shared dataset config for the selected environment."""
    return {
        "env_name": ENV_NAME,
        "batch_size": batch_size,
        "num_workers": 0,
        "pin_mem": False,
        "persistent_workers": False,
    }


def resolve_checkpoint_path():
    """Choose the released checkpoint by default, with local fallback."""
    if not FORCE_TRAIN and PRETRAINED_CKPT_PATH.exists():
        return PRETRAINED_CKPT_PATH
    if CKPT_PATH.exists():
        return CKPT_PATH
    return None


def setup_seed(seed):
    """Set random seeds for reproducibility."""
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed(seed)
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)


def build_model(device, loader):
    """Build the JEPA model with all components."""
    img_size = loader.dataset.config.img_size

    # Encoder
    encoder = ImpalaEncoder(
        width=1,
        stack_sizes=(16, HENC, DSTC),
        num_blocks=2,
        dropout_rate=None,
        layer_norm=False,
        input_channels=DOBS,
        final_ln=True,
        mlp_output_dim=512,
        input_shape=(DOBS, img_size, img_size),
    )
    test_input = torch.rand((1, DOBS, 1, img_size, img_size))
    test_output = encoder(test_input)
    _, f, _, h, w = test_output.shape

    # Predictor
    predictor = RNNPredictor(
        hidden_size=encoder.mlp_output_dim, final_ln=encoder.final_ln
    )

    # Action encoder (identity)
    aencoder = nn.Identity()

    # IDM
    idm = InverseDynamicsModel(
        state_dim=h * w * f,
        hidden_dim=256,
        action_dim=2,
    ).to(device)

    # Regularizer
    regularizer = VC_IDM_Sim_Regularizer(
        cov_coeff=COV_COEFF,
        std_coeff=STD_COEFF,
        sim_coeff_t=SIM_COEFF_T,
        idm_coeff=IDM_COEFF,
        idm=idm,
        first_t_only=False,
        projector=None,
        spatial_as_samples=False,
        idm_after_proj=False,
        sim_t_after_proj=False,
    )

    # Loss and JEPA
    ploss = SquareLossSeq()
    jepa = JEPA(encoder, aencoder, predictor, regularizer, ploss).to(device)

    # Position prober
    xy_head = MLPXYHead(
        input_shape=test_output.shape[1],
        normalizer=loader.dataset.normalizer,
    ).to(device)
    xy_prober = JEPAProbe(jepa=jepa, head=xy_head, hcost=nn.MSELoss())

    return jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, test_output.shape


def train_model(device):
    """Train the AC Video JEPA model and save checkpoint."""
    print("Training AC Video JEPA model...")

    loader, val_loader, data_config = init_data(
        env_name=ENV_NAME,
        cfg_data=build_data_cfg(BATCH_SIZE),
    )

    jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, _ = build_model(device, loader)

    steps_per_epoch = data_config.size // data_config.batch_size
    total_steps = EPOCHS * steps_per_epoch

    jepa_optimizer = AdamW(jepa.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=WEIGHT_DECAY)
    jepa_scheduler = CosineWithWarmup(jepa_optimizer, total_steps, warmup_ratio=0.1)

    probe_optimizer = AdamW(xy_head.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-5)
    probe_scheduler = CosineWithWarmup(probe_optimizer, total_steps, warmup_ratio=0.1)

    dtype = torch.bfloat16
    use_amp = True
    scaler = GradScaler(device.type, enabled=use_amp)

    for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
        epoch_start = time.time()
        pbar = tqdm(
            enumerate(loader),
            total=len(loader),
            desc=f"Epoch {epoch}/{EPOCHS - 1}",
        )
        for idx, (x, a, loc, _, _) in pbar:
            x = x.to(device)
            a = a.to(device)
            loc = loc.to(device)
            total_loss = torch.tensor(0.0, device=device)

            # JEPA loss
            jepa_optimizer.zero_grad()
            with autocast(device.type, enabled=use_amp, dtype=dtype):
                _, (jepa_loss, regl, regl_unweight, regldict, pl) = jepa.unroll(
                    x, a,
                    nsteps=NSTEPS,
                    unroll_mode="autoregressive",
                    ctxt_window_time=1,
                    compute_loss=True,
                    return_all_steps=False,
                )
                total_loss += jepa_loss

            scaler.scale(jepa_loss).backward()
            scaler.unscale_(jepa_optimizer)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(jepa.encoder.parameters(), GRAD_CLIP)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(jepa.predictor.parameters(), GRAD_CLIP)
            scaler.step(jepa_optimizer)
            scaler.update()
            jepa_scheduler.step()

            # Probe loss
            probe_optimizer.zero_grad()
            with autocast(device.type, enabled=use_amp, dtype=dtype):
                xy_loss = xy_prober(
                    observations=x[:, :, :1],
                    targets=loc[:, :, :1],
                )
                xy_loss = loader.dataset.normalizer.unnormalize_mse(xy_loss)
                total_loss += xy_loss

            scaler.scale(xy_loss).backward()
            scaler.step(probe_optimizer)
            scaler.update()
            probe_scheduler.step()

            pbar.set_postfix({
                "loss": f"{total_loss.item():.4f}",
                "reg": f"{regl.item():.4f}",
                "pred": f"{pl.item():.4f}",
            })

        epoch_time = time.time() - epoch_start
        print(
            f"TRAIN_METRICS: epoch={epoch}, loss={total_loss.item():.4f}, "
            f"reg={regl.item():.4f}, pred={pl.item():.4f}, "
            f"probe={xy_loss.item():.4f}, time={epoch_time:.1f}s",
            flush=True,
        )

    # Save checkpoint
    os.makedirs(CKPT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    ckpt = {
        "epoch": EPOCHS - 1,
        "model_state_dict": jepa.state_dict(),
        "xy_head_state_dict": xy_head.state_dict(),
    }
    torch.save(ckpt, CKPT_PATH)
    print(f"Checkpoint saved to {CKPT_PATH}", flush=True)

    return jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, loader


def load_model(device):
    """Load the JEPA model from checkpoint."""
    loader, val_loader, data_config = init_data(
        env_name=ENV_NAME,
        cfg_data=build_data_cfg(64),
    )

    jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, _ = build_model(device, loader)

    checkpoint_path = resolve_checkpoint_path()
    if checkpoint_path is None:
        raise FileNotFoundError(

class CustomPlanner(Planner):
    """Gradient-Augmented MPPI Planner for JEPA world models."""

    def __init__(self, unroll, action_dim=2, plan_length=15,

        model = None
        try:
            model = self.unroll.__self__.model
            model.train()
        except AttributeError:
            pass

        try:
            with torch.enable_grad():
                from einops import rearrange
                
                plan_length = min(self.plan_length, steps_left) if steps_left else self.plan_length
                
                mean = torch.zeros(plan_length, self.action_dim, device=self.device)
                std = 1.5 * torch.ones(plan_length, self.action_dim, device=self.device)
                
                best_action = torch.zeros(plan_length, self.action_dim, device=self.device)
                best_cost = float('inf')
                
                for _ in range(self.n_iters):
                    noise = torch.randn(plan_length, self.num_samples, self.action_dim, device=self.device)
                    for t in range(1, plan_length):
                        noise[t] = self.noise_alpha * noise[t-1] + (1 - self.noise_alpha) * noise[t]
                        
                    noise_std = noise.std(dim=1, keepdim=True)
                    noise = noise / (noise_std + 1e-8)
                        
                    actions = mean.unsqueeze(1) + std.unsqueeze(1) * noise
                    actions.requires_grad_(True)
                    
                    norms = actions.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
                    actions_clipped = actions * (self.max_norm / norms.clamp(min=1e-6)).clamp(max=1.0)
                    
                    actions_bat = rearrange(actions_clipped, "t b a -> b a t")
                    cost = self.cost_function(actions_bat, obs_init)
                    
                    loss = cost.sum()
                    grad = torch.autograd.grad(loss, actions)[0]
                    
                    with torch.no_grad():
                        grad_norm = grad.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
                        grad_scaled = grad / torch.clamp(grad_norm, min=1.0)
                        actions_updated = actions - self.gd_lr * grad_scaled
                        
                        norms_up = actions_updated.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
                        actions_clipped_up = actions_updated * (self.max_norm / norms_up.clamp(min=1e-6)).clamp(max=1.0)
                        
                        cost_up = self.cost_function(rearrange(actions_clipped_up, "t b a -> b a t"), obs_init)

                        if min_cost < best_cost:
                            best_cost = min_cost
                            best_action = actions_clipped_up[:, cost_up.argmin()].detach()
                            
                        weights = torch.exp(-self.temperature * (cost_up - min_cost))
                        weights /= weights.sum() + 1e-9
                        
                        mean = torch.sum(weights.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(2) * actions_clipped_up, dim=1)
                        std = torch.sqrt(torch.sum(weights.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(2) * (actions_clipped_up - mean.unsqueeze(1))**2, dim=1) + 1e-3)

                .unsqueeze(0)

                ).cpu().numpy()

            flush=True,

        f"TEST_METRICS: success_rate={success_rate:.2f}, "
        f"mean_dist={mean_dist:.4f}, "
        f"mean_steps_to_success={mean_steps:.2f}",
        flush=True,
    )
    return success_rate, mean_dist


# ============================================================================
# Main Entry Point
# ============================================================================

def main():

    setup_seed(SEED)
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    print(f"Using device: {device}", flush=True)

class CustomPlanner(Planner):
    """Smooth Trajectory CEM: CEM over basis-function parameterized action trajectories.

    Novel algorithmic contributions:
    1. Basis-function parameterization: Instead of sampling independent per-timestep
       actions (which creates jagged, inefficient trajectories), we parameterize
       action sequences as linear combinations of smooth basis functions (cosine
       modes). This reduces the search space dimensionality while enforcing temporal
       smoothness, which is critical for continuous navigation tasks.
    2. Dual-frequency CEM: Optimizes coarse (low-frequency) and fine (high-frequency)
       trajectory components in alternating phases, enabling hierarchical trajectory
       refinement.
    3. MPC warm-starting with basis coefficient shift for efficient replanning.
    4. Elite rejuvenation: Injects random samples each CEM iteration to prevent
       premature convergence and maintain exploration diversity.
    5. Adaptive elite fraction based on iteration progress.

    def __init__(self, unroll, action_dim=2, plan_length=15,
                 num_samples=200, n_iters=20, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(unroll)
        self.action_dim = action_dim
        self.plan_length = plan_length
        self.num_samples = num_samples
        self.n_iters = n_iters
        self.device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

        # Basis function configuration
        self.n_basis_low = 4    # Low-frequency basis functions (coarse trajectory shape)
        self.n_basis_high = 4   # High-frequency basis functions (fine corrections)
        self.n_basis_total = self.n_basis_low + self.n_basis_high  # Total basis functions

        # CEM configuration
        self.var_scale = 1.0
        self.max_norm = 2.45
        self.rejuvenate_frac = 0.15  # Fraction of random samples injected each iter

        # MPC warm-start state
        self.prev_coeffs = None

        # Basis matrix will be computed per plan_length in plan()
        self._basis_matrices = {}

    def _get_basis_matrix(self, plan_length):
        """Compute the basis function matrix for given plan length.

        Returns matrix [plan_length, n_basis_total] where each column is a
        normalized cosine basis function. Low-frequency modes capture the
        overall trajectory shape; high-frequency modes capture local corrections.
        """
        if plan_length in self._basis_matrices:
            return self._basis_matrices[plan_length]

        t = torch.linspace(0, 1, plan_length, device=self.device)
        basis = torch.zeros(plan_length, self.n_basis_total, device=self.device)

        # Low-frequency cosine modes (global trajectory shape)
        for k in range(self.n_basis_low):
            freq = k  # frequencies 0, 1, 2, 3
            basis[:, k] = torch.cos(freq * torch.pi * t)

        # High-frequency cosine modes (local trajectory corrections)
        for k in range(self.n_basis_high):
            freq = self.n_basis_low + k  # frequencies 4, 5, 6, 7
            basis[:, self.n_basis_low + k] = torch.cos(freq * torch.pi * t)

        # Normalize each basis function to unit norm
        norms = basis.norm(dim=0, keepdim=True)
        basis = basis / norms.clamp(min=1e-6)

        self._basis_matrices[plan_length] = basis
        return basis

        """Convert basis coefficients [B, n_basis_total, A] to actions [T, B, A]."""
        # coeffs: [B, n_basis_total, action_dim]
        # basis_matrix: [T, n_basis_total]
        # actions: [T, B, A] = basis_matrix @ coeffs
        actions = torch.einsum('tb,bad->tad', basis_matrix, coeffs)

    def plan(self, obs_init, steps_left=None, eval_mode=True,

        if self.prev_coeffs is not None and not t0:

            # and zero out high-frequency ones (let CEM re-discover fine corrections)
            shifted = torch.zeros(self.n_basis_total, self.action_dim, device=self.device)

        # then Phase 2 refines only high-frequency coefficients with frozen low-freq.
        total_iters = self.n_iters

        phase2_iters = max(2, total_iters - phase1_iters)

        best_coeffs = mean.clone()

        for i in range(phase1_iters):

            decay = max(0.2, 1.0 - 0.8 * i / max(1, phase1_iters - 1))
            cur_std = std * decay

            # Sample elite-rejuvenated population
            n_rejuvenate = int(self.num_samples * self.rejuvenate_frac)
            n_cem = self.num_samples - n_rejuvenate

            # CEM samples from current distribution
            coeffs_cem = mean.unsqueeze(0) + cur_std.unsqueeze(0) * torch.randn(
                n_cem, self.n_basis_total, self.action_dim, device=self.device
            )

            # Pure random samples for exploration diversity
            coeffs_random = cur_std.unsqueeze(0) * torch.randn(
                n_rejuvenate, self.n_basis_total, self.action_dim, device=self.device
            )

            # Concatenate all samples
            coeffs = torch.cat([coeffs_cem, coeffs_random], dim=0)

            # Convert to action sequences
            actions = self._coeffs_to_actions(coeffs, basis_matrix)

            # Project action norms to feasible range
            norms = actions.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
            actions = actions * (self.max_norm / norms.clamp(min=1e-6)).clamp(max=1.0)

                rearrange(actions, "t b a -> b a t"), obs_init
            )

                best_coeffs = coeffs[min_idx].clone()

            elite_frac = max(0.05, 0.2 - 0.15 * i / max(1, phase1_iters - 1))

            elite_coeffs = coeffs[elite_idxs]

            mean = torch.mean(elite_coeffs, dim=0)
            std = torch.std(elite_coeffs, dim=0).clamp(min=0.02)

        # === Phase 2: Fine refinement with frozen coarse coefficients ===
        # Freeze low-frequency coefficients from Phase 1, optimize only
        # high-frequency corrections. This allows precise trajectory adjustment
        # without destabilizing the overall trajectory shape.
        fine_mean = mean[self.n_basis_low:].clone()
        fine_std = std[self.n_basis_low:].clone() * 1.5  # Start with wider exploration for fine modes
        coarse_mean = mean[:self.n_basis_low].clone()

            )
            fine_coeffs_random = cur_fine_std.unsqueeze(0) * torch.randn(
                n_rejuvenate, self.n_basis_high, self.action_dim, device=self.device
            )

                coarse_mean.unsqueeze(0).expand(self.num_samples, -1, -1),

            ], dim=1)

                rearrange(actions, "t b a -> b a t"), obs_init
            )

        self.prev_coeffs = best_coeffs.clone()

# PART 3: Planning Evaluation
# ============================================================================

def create_env(data_config):
    """Create the Two Rooms evaluation environment."""
    if ENV_NAME != "two_rooms":
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported ENV='{TASK_ENV}' for jepa-planning")
    return DotWall(
        config=data_config,
        n_allowed_steps=200,
        level="normal",
    )

    # The planner needs access to model unroll through the GCAgent's unroll method

        def __init__(self, model, planner, normalizer, env, prober):

            self.planner = planner
            self.normalizer = normalizer
            self.env = env
            self.device = next(model.parameters()).device
            self.loc_prober = prober
            self.goal_state = None
            self.goal_position = None
            self.goal_state_enc = None
            self.objective = None
            self.num_act_stepped = 1

            self.planner.unroll = self.unroll

            batch_size = actions.shape[0]
            nsteps = actions.shape[2]

                obs_init_rep = obs_init.repeat(batch_size, 1, 1, 1, 1)
            else:
                obs_init_rep = obs_init
            predicted_states, _ = self.model.unroll(
                obs_init_rep, actions,
                nsteps=nsteps,
                unroll_mode="autoregressive",
                ctxt_window_time=1,
                compute_loss=False,
                return_all_steps=False,
            )

        def set_goal(self, goal_state, goal_position=None):
            self.goal_position = goal_position
            self.goal_state = goal_state
            self.goal_state_enc = self.model.encode(
                self.normalizer.normalize_state(goal_state.to(self.device))
                .unsqueeze(0)
                .unsqueeze(2)
            )
            self.objective = ReprTargetDistMPCObjective(
                target_enc=self.goal_state_enc,
                sum_all_diffs=True,
            )
            self.planner.set_objective(self.objective)

        def act(self, obs_tensor, steps_left=None, t0=False):
            planning_result = self.planner.plan(
                obs_tensor,
                steps_left=steps_left,
                eval_mode=True,
                t0=t0,
            )
            return planning_result.actions[:self.num_act_stepped]

    agent = PlanningAgent(jepa, planner, normalizer, env, xy_prober)

    successes = []
    distances = []
    steps_to_success = []

    for ep in range(num_episodes):
        obs, info = env.reset()
        obs, reward, done, truncated, info = env.step(
            np.zeros(env.action_space.shape[0])
        )
        goal_img = info["target_obs"]

        agent.set_goal(
            goal_img.detach().clone().to(dtype=torch.float32),
            info["target_position"],
        )

        steps_left = env.n_allowed_steps
        total_steps = env.n_allowed_steps
        t0 = True
        success = False
        state_dist = float("inf")
        first_success_step = None

        while steps_left > 0:
            obs_tensor = (
                normalizer.normalize_state(
                    obs.detach().clone().to(dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
                )
                .unsqueeze(0)
                .unsqueeze(2)
            )
            with torch.no_grad():
                action = agent.act(
                    obs_tensor, steps_left=steps_left, t0=t0
                ).cpu().numpy()

            for a in action:
                obs, reward, done, truncated, info = env.step(a)
                t0 = False
                steps_left -= 1

                eval_results = env.eval_state(
                    info["target_position"], info["dot_position"]
                )
                success = eval_results["success"]
                state_dist = eval_results["state_dist"]

                if success and first_success_step is None:
                    first_success_step = total_steps - steps_left
                if done or truncated or steps_left <= 0:
                    break
            if done or truncated:
                break

        successes.append(success)
        distances.append(state_dist)
        if first_success_step is not None:
            steps_to_success.append(first_success_step)
        print(
            f"PLAN_METRICS: episode={ep}, success={success}, dist={state_dist:.4f}",
            flush=True,
        )

    success_rate = np.mean(successes)
    mean_dist = np.mean(distances)
    mean_steps = np.mean(steps_to_success) if steps_to_success else float("nan")
    print(
        f"TEST_METRICS: success_rate={success_rate:.2f}, "
        f"mean_dist={mean_dist:.4f}, "
        f"mean_steps_to_success={mean_steps:.2f}",
        flush=True,
    )
    return success_rate, mean_dist


# ============================================================================
# Main Entry Point
# ============================================================================

def main():
    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    setup_seed(SEED)
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    print(f"Using device: {device}", flush=True)
    print(
        f"Runtime config: seed={SEED}, env={TASK_ENV}, output_dir={OUTPUT_DIR}",
        flush=True,
    )

    # Part 1: Load released checkpoint by default, retrain only as a fallback.
    if resolve_checkpoint_path() is not None and not FORCE_TRAIN:
        jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, loader = load_model(device)
    else:

            print("JEPA_FORCE_TRAIN=1 -> retraining world model", flush=True)
        else:

                f"Released checkpoint missing at {PRETRAINED_CKPT_PATH}; "
                "falling back to local training.",
                flush=True,
            )

    # Part 3: Planning evaluation
    success_rate, mean_dist = run_planning_eval(
        jepa, xy_prober, loader, device, num_episodes=20
    )

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        self.smooth_coeff = 0.05
        self.fd_lr = 0.3
        self.fd_delta = 0.05
        self.mppi_temp = 0.01
        self.device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

    @torch.no_grad()
    def plan(self, obs_init, steps_left=None, eval_mode=True,
             t0=False, plan_vis_path=None):
        from einops import rearrange

        plan_length = min(self.plan_length, steps_left) if steps_left else self.plan_length

        mean = torch.zeros(plan_length, self.action_dim, device=self.device)
        std = self.var_scale * torch.ones(plan_length, self.action_dim, device=self.device)
        actions = torch.empty(plan_length, self.num_samples, self.action_dim, device=self.device)

        losses = []
        elite_means = []
        elite_stds = []

        for it in range(self.n_iters):
            # 1. Sample around current mean
            actions[:, :] = mean.unsqueeze(1) + std.unsqueeze(1) * torch.randn(
                plan_length, self.num_samples, self.action_dim, device=self.device,
            )

            # 2. Clip action norms
            norms = actions.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
            actions = actions * (self.max_norm / norms.clamp(min=1e-6)).clamp(max=1.0)

            # 3. Evaluate population
            cost = self.cost_function(
                rearrange(actions, "t b a -> b a t"), obs_init
            ).unsqueeze(1)
            losses.append(cost.min().item())

            # 4. Select elites
            elite_vals, elite_idxs = torch.topk(-cost.squeeze(1), self.num_elites, dim=0)
            elite_loss = -elite_vals
            elite_actions = actions[:, elite_idxs]

            elite_means.append(elite_loss.mean().item())
            elite_stds.append(elite_loss.std().item())

            # 5. MPPI weighted mean
            min_cost = cost.min(0)[0]
            score = torch.exp(self.mppi_temp * (min_cost - elite_loss))
            score = score / (score.sum(0) + 1e-9)
            weighted_mean = torch.sum(
                score.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(2) * elite_actions, dim=1
            )

            # 6. Finite-difference gradient of the objective w.r.t. the mean
            #    We perturb each action dimension by +/-fd_delta and evaluate.
            fd_grad = torch.zeros_like(weighted_mean)
            if self.fd_lr > 0.0 and self.fd_delta > 0.0:
                # Build perturbed actions: [T, 2*A, A]
                delta = self.fd_delta
                eye = torch.eye(self.action_dim, device=self.device) * delta  # [A, A]
                pos = weighted_mean.unsqueeze(1) + eye.unsqueeze(0)   # [T, A, A]
                neg = weighted_mean.unsqueeze(1) - eye.unsqueeze(0)   # [T, A, A]
                perturbed = torch.cat([pos, neg], dim=1)               # [T, 2A, A]
                # Clip norms
                p_norms = perturbed.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
                perturbed = perturbed * (self.max_norm / p_norms.clamp(min=1e-6)).clamp(max=1.0)
                # Evaluate
                p_cost = self.cost_function(
                    rearrange(perturbed, "t b a -> b a t"), obs_init
                )  # [2A]
                pos_cost = p_cost[:self.action_dim]
                neg_cost = p_cost[self.action_dim:]
                fd_grad = (pos_cost - neg_cost).view(1, self.action_dim) / (2.0 * delta)
                fd_grad = fd_grad.expand_as(weighted_mean)

            # 7. Smoothness gradient
            smooth_grad = torch.zeros_like(weighted_mean)
            smooth_grad[1:-1] = 2.0 * (
                2.0 * weighted_mean[1:-1]
                - weighted_mean[:-2]
                - weighted_mean[2:]
            )
            smooth_grad[0] = 2.0 * (weighted_mean[0] - weighted_mean[1])
            smooth_grad[-1] = 2.0 * (weighted_mean[-1] - weighted_mean[-2])

            # 8. Combined update
            mean = weighted_mean - self.fd_lr * fd_grad - self.smooth_coeff * smooth_grad

            # 9. Re-project mean into feasible set
            mean_norms = mean.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
            mean = mean * (self.max_norm / mean_norms.clamp(min=1e-6)).clamp(max=1.0)

            # 10. Shrink std
            std = torch.std(elite_actions, dim=1)
            std = std * (1.0 - 0.5 * (it + 1) / self.n_iters)
            std = std.clamp(min=0.02)

        return PlanningResult(
            actions=mean,
            losses=torch.tensor(losses).detach().unsqueeze(-1),
            prev_elite_losses_mean=torch.tensor(elite_means).unsqueeze(-1),
            prev_elite_losses_std=torch.tensor(elite_stds).unsqueeze(-1),
        )


# ============================================================================
# PART 3: Planning Evaluation
# ============================================================================

def create_env(data_config):
    """Create the Two Rooms evaluation environment."""
    if ENV_NAME != "two_rooms":
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported ENV='{TASK_ENV}' for jepa-planning")
    return DotWall(
        config=data_config,
        n_allowed_steps=200,
        level="normal",
    )


def run_planning_eval(jepa, xy_prober, loader, device, num_episodes=20):
    """Run planning evaluation with the CustomPlanner."""
    jepa.eval()

    data_config = loader.dataset.config
    env = create_env(data_config)
    env.reset()

    # Create a lightweight GCAgent-like wrapper that uses CustomPlanner
    normalizer = env.normalizer

    # Create the planner
    planner = CustomPlanner(
        unroll=None,  # Will be set via agent wrapper
        action_dim=2,
        plan_length=PLAN_LENGTH,
        num_samples=200,
        n_iters=20,
    )

    # We need to wire up the unroll function properly
    # The planner needs access to model unroll through the GCAgent's unroll method
    class PlanningAgent:
        def __init__(self, model, planner, normalizer, env, prober):
            self.model = model
            self.planner = planner
            self.normalizer = normalizer
            self.env = env
            self.device = next(model.parameters()).device
            self.loc_prober = prober
            self.goal_state = None
            self.goal_position = None
            self.goal_state_enc = None
            self.objective = None
            self.num_act_stepped = 1

            # Wire planner's unroll to agent's unroll
            self.planner.unroll = self.unroll

        def unroll(self, obs_init, actions, repeat_batch=True):
            batch_size = actions.shape[0]
            nsteps = actions.shape[2]
            if repeat_batch:
                obs_init_rep = obs_init.repeat(batch_size, 1, 1, 1, 1)
            else:
                obs_init_rep = obs_init
            predicted_states, _ = self.model.unroll(
                obs_init_rep, actions,
                nsteps=nsteps,
                unroll_mode="autoregressive",
                ctxt_window_time=1,
                compute_loss=False,
                return_all_steps=False,
            )
            return predicted_states

        def set_goal(self, goal_state, goal_position=None):
            self.goal_position = goal_position
            self.goal_state = goal_state
            self.goal_state_enc = self.model.encode(
                self.normalizer.normalize_state(goal_state.to(self.device))
                .unsqueeze(0)
                .unsqueeze(2)
            )
            self.objective = ReprTargetDistMPCObjective(
                target_enc=self.goal_state_enc,
                sum_all_diffs=True,
            )
            self.planner.set_objective(self.objective)

        def act(self, obs_tensor, steps_left=None, t0=False):
            planning_result = self.planner.plan(
                obs_tensor,
                steps_left=steps_left,
                eval_mode=True,
                t0=t0,
            )
            return planning_result.actions[:self.num_act_stepped]

    agent = PlanningAgent(jepa, planner, normalizer, env, xy_prober)

    successes = []
    distances = []
    steps_to_success = []

    for ep in range(num_episodes):
        obs, info = env.reset()
        obs, reward, done, truncated, info = env.step(
            np.zeros(env.action_space.shape[0])
        )
        goal_img = info["target_obs"]

        agent.set_goal(
            goal_img.detach().clone().to(dtype=torch.float32),
            info["target_position"],
        )

        steps_left = env.n_allowed_steps
        total_steps = env.n_allowed_steps
        t0 = True
        success = False
        state_dist = float("inf")
        first_success_step = None

        while steps_left > 0:
            obs_tensor = (
                normalizer.normalize_state(
                    obs.detach().clone().to(dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
                )
                .unsqueeze(0)
                .unsqueeze(2)
            )
            with torch.no_grad():
                action = agent.act(
                    obs_tensor, steps_left=steps_left, t0=t0
                ).cpu().numpy()

            for a in action:
                obs, reward, done, truncated, info = env.step(a)
                t0 = False
                steps_left -= 1

                eval_results = env.eval_state(
                    info["target_position"], info["dot_position"]
                )
                success = eval_results["success"]
                state_dist = eval_results["state_dist"]

                if success and first_success_step is None:
                    first_success_step = total_steps - steps_left
                if done or truncated or steps_left <= 0:
                    break
            if done or truncated:
                break

        successes.append(success)
        distances.append(state_dist)
        if first_success_step is not None:
            steps_to_success.append(first_success_step)
        print(
            f"PLAN_METRICS: episode={ep}, success={success}, dist={state_dist:.4f}",
            flush=True,
        )

    success_rate = np.mean(successes)
    mean_dist = np.mean(distances)
    mean_steps = np.mean(steps_to_success) if steps_to_success else float("nan")
    print(
        f"TEST_METRICS: success_rate={success_rate:.2f}, "
        f"mean_dist={mean_dist:.4f}, "
        f"mean_steps_to_success={mean_steps:.2f}",
        flush=True,
    )
    return success_rate, mean_dist


# ============================================================================
# Main Entry Point
# ============================================================================

def main():
    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    setup_seed(SEED)
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    print(f"Using device: {device}", flush=True)
    print(
        f"Runtime config: seed={SEED}, env={TASK_ENV}, output_dir={OUTPUT_DIR}",
        flush=True,
    )

    # Part 1: Load released checkpoint by default, retrain only as a fallback.
    if resolve_checkpoint_path() is not None and not FORCE_TRAIN:
        jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, loader = load_model(device)
    else:
        if FORCE_TRAIN:
            print("JEPA_FORCE_TRAIN=1 -> retraining world model", flush=True)
        else:
            print(
                f"Released checkpoint missing at {PRETRAINED_CKPT_PATH}; "
                "falling back to local training.",
                flush=True,
            )
        jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, loader = train_model(device)

    # Part 3: Planning evaluation
    success_rate, mean_dist = run_planning_eval(
        jepa, xy_prober, loader, device, num_episodes=20
    )
    print(f"\nFinal Results: success_rate={success_rate:.2f}, mean_dist={mean_dist:.4f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Part 1: Load a released AC Video JEPA checkpoint (or retrain on demand).

Part 3: Run planning evaluation and report metrics.

import os
import sys

# Prevent eb_jepa/logging.py from shadowing stdlib logging
_script_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path = [p for p in sys.path if not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(p, "logging.py"))]

# os is imported above before sys.path filtering.
import random
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.amp import GradScaler, autocast
from torch.optim import AdamW
from tqdm import tqdm

from eb_jepa.architectures import (
    ImpalaEncoder,
    InverseDynamicsModel,
    RNNPredictor,
)
from eb_jepa.datasets.two_rooms.env import DotWall
from eb_jepa.datasets.utils import init_data
from eb_jepa.jepa import JEPA, JEPAProbe
from eb_jepa.losses import SquareLossSeq, VC_IDM_Sim_Regularizer
from eb_jepa.planning import (
    Planner,
    PlanningResult,
    ReprTargetDistMPCObjective,
)
from eb_jepa.schedulers import CosineWithWarmup
from eb_jepa.state_decoder import MLPXYHead

# ============================================================================
# PART 1: Model Training / Checkpoint Loading
# ============================================================================

# Training hyperparameters (from train.yaml)
TASK_ENV = os.environ.get("JEPA_ENV", "two-rooms")
ENV_NAME = TASK_ENV.replace("-", "_")
SEED = int(os.environ.get("SEED", "42"))
PLAN_LENGTH = int(os.environ.get("PLAN_LENGTH", "90"))
OUTPUT_DIR = Path(os.environ.get("OUTPUT_DIR", "/workspace/eb_jepa/outputs"))
CKPT_DIR = OUTPUT_DIR / "checkpoints"
CKPT_PATH = CKPT_DIR / "ac_jepa.pth.tar"
PRETRAINED_CKPT_PATH = Path(
    os.environ.get(
        "JEPA_PRETRAINED_CKPT",
        "/data/eb_jepa/checkpoints/ac_jepa_e11.pth.tar",
    )
)
FORCE_TRAIN = os.environ.get("JEPA_FORCE_TRAIN", "0") == "1"
EPOCHS = 12
BATCH_SIZE = 384
LR = 0.001
WEIGHT_DECAY = 1e-5
GRAD_CLIP = 2.0
DOBS = 2
HENC = 32
DSTC = 32
NSTEPS = 8
COV_COEFF = 8
STD_COEFF = 16
SIM_COEFF_T = 12
IDM_COEFF = 1


def build_data_cfg(batch_size):
    """Create the shared dataset config for the selected environment."""
    return {
        "env_name": ENV_NAME,
        "batch_size": batch_size,
        "num_workers": 0,
        "pin_mem": False,
        "persistent_workers": False,
    }


def resolve_checkpoint_path():
    """Choose the released checkpoint by default, with local fallback."""
    if not FORCE_TRAIN and PRETRAINED_CKPT_PATH.exists():
        return PRETRAINED_CKPT_PATH
    if CKPT_PATH.exists():
        return CKPT_PATH
    return None


def setup_seed(seed):
    """Set random seeds for reproducibility."""
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed(seed)
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)


def build_model(device, loader):
    """Build the JEPA model with all components."""
    img_size = loader.dataset.config.img_size

    # Encoder
    encoder = ImpalaEncoder(
        width=1,
        stack_sizes=(16, HENC, DSTC),
        num_blocks=2,
        dropout_rate=None,
        layer_norm=False,
        input_channels=DOBS,
        final_ln=True,
        mlp_output_dim=512,
        input_shape=(DOBS, img_size, img_size),
    )
    test_input = torch.rand((1, DOBS, 1, img_size, img_size))
    test_output = encoder(test_input)
    _, f, _, h, w = test_output.shape

    # Predictor
    predictor = RNNPredictor(
        hidden_size=encoder.mlp_output_dim, final_ln=encoder.final_ln
    )

    # Action encoder (identity)
    aencoder = nn.Identity()

    # IDM
    idm = InverseDynamicsModel(
        state_dim=h * w * f,
        hidden_dim=256,
        action_dim=2,
    ).to(device)

    # Regularizer
    regularizer = VC_IDM_Sim_Regularizer(
        cov_coeff=COV_COEFF,
        std_coeff=STD_COEFF,
        sim_coeff_t=SIM_COEFF_T,
        idm_coeff=IDM_COEFF,
        idm=idm,
        first_t_only=False,
        projector=None,
        spatial_as_samples=False,
        idm_after_proj=False,
        sim_t_after_proj=False,
    )

    # Loss and JEPA
    ploss = SquareLossSeq()
    jepa = JEPA(encoder, aencoder, predictor, regularizer, ploss).to(device)

    # Position prober
    xy_head = MLPXYHead(
        input_shape=test_output.shape[1],
        normalizer=loader.dataset.normalizer,
    ).to(device)
    xy_prober = JEPAProbe(jepa=jepa, head=xy_head, hcost=nn.MSELoss())

    return jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, test_output.shape


def train_model(device):
    """Train the AC Video JEPA model and save checkpoint."""
    print("Training AC Video JEPA model...")

    loader, val_loader, data_config = init_data(
        env_name=ENV_NAME,
        cfg_data=build_data_cfg(BATCH_SIZE),
    )

    jepa, xy_head, xy_prober, _ = build_model(device, loader)

    steps_per_epoch = data_config.size // data_config.batch_size
    total_steps = EPOCHS * steps_per_epoch

    jepa_optimizer = AdamW(jepa.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=WEIGHT_DECAY)
    jepa_scheduler = CosineWithWarmup(jepa_optimizer, total_steps, warmup_ratio=0.1)

    probe_optimizer = AdamW(xy_head.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-5)
    probe_scheduler = CosineWithWarmup(probe_optimizer, total_steps, warmup_ratio=0.1)

    dtype = torch.bfloat16
    use_amp = True
    scaler = GradScaler(device.type, enabled=use_amp)

    for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
        epoch_start = time.time()
        pbar = tqdm(
            enumerate(loader),
            total=len(loader),
            desc=f"Epoch {epoch}/{EPOCHS - 1}",
        )
        for idx, (x, a, loc, _, _) in pbar:
            x = x.to(device)
            a = a.to(device)
            loc = loc.to(device)
            total_loss = torch.tensor(0.0, device=device)

            # JEPA loss
            jepa_optimizer.zero_grad()
            with autocast(device.type, enabled=use_amp, dtype=dtype):
                _, (jepa_loss, regl, regl_unweight, regldict, pl) = jepa.unroll(
                    x, a,
                    nsteps=NSTEPS,
                    unroll_mode="autoregressive",
                    ctxt_window_time=1,
                    compute_loss=True,
                    return_all_steps=False,
                )
                total_loss += jepa_loss

            scaler.scale(jepa_loss).backward()
            scaler.unscale_(jepa_optimizer)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(jepa.encoder.parameters(), GRAD_CLIP)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(jepa.predictor.parameters(), GRAD_CLIP)
            scaler.step(jepa_optimizer)
            scaler.update()
            jepa_scheduler.step()

            # Probe loss
            probe_optimizer.zero_grad()
            with autocast(device.type, enabled=use_amp, dtype=dtype):
                xy_loss = xy_prober(
                    observations=x[:, :, :1],
                    targets=loc[:, :, :1],
                )
                xy_loss = loader.dataset.normalizer.unnormalize_mse(xy_loss)
                total_loss += xy_loss

            scaler.scale(xy_loss).backward()
            scaler.step(probe_optimizer)
            scaler.update()
            probe_scheduler.step()

            pbar.set_postfix({
                "loss": f"{total_loss.item():.4f}",
                "reg": f"{regl.item():.4f}",
                "pred": f"{pl.item():.4f}",
            })

        epoch_time = time.time() - epoch_start
        print(
            f"TRAIN_METRICS: epoch={epoch}, loss={total_loss.item():.4f}, "
            f"reg={regl.item():.4f}, pred={pl.item():.4f}, "
            f"probe={xy_loss.item():.4f}, time={epoch_time:.1f}s",
            flush=True,
